system.description:
Favoured weapon: Dagger

Granted power: Tenet: Study magic, and respect its danger.

  • Advantage on all Knowledge and Lore checks.
  • Once/day: ask the GM one yes/no question about the current situation and receive a truthful answer (no more than once about the same matter in a day).
  • Once per round, on a hit of yours or when a creature fails a save against your spell, you learn one of its resistances, vulnerabilities or immunities.

Allegiance: Neutral Good, the god's alignment, held while the god favours you. Tenets: on Mystra in the World of Arneyan wiki.
